title: Beautiful For You
description: Improve animations and vanilla-like visual gameplay also friendly for most servers.
body:
**This modpack is designed for those who want a more enjoyable and modern _Minecraft experience_ without changing its core gameplay.**

The main goal of the modpack is to make the game smoother, more beautiful, and more lively, while maintaining its vanilla atmosphere.

# ✨ What does the modpack do?

## 🔧 Optimization
The modpack includes a number of mods that significantly improve the game's performance. This helps increase FPS, reduce lag, and make gameplay more stable even on low-end computers.
![FPS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6c42b1ad13f0ac7a25cbb8f11b56faf4080f4e9_0.webp)

## 🎬 Improved Animations
Player, camera, and other element movements become smoother and more natural. This makes the game feel much more alive.
![Animations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c5e0f52ee63ea59df6e458a2cc4a15ad1fc02c6_0.webp)

## 🎨 Visual Improvements
Many small visual details and interface improvements have been added that make the game more enjoyable and modern without overloading it with unnecessary changes.
![Visual enchance](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80f4edf8c9212fa8cee53bf47abacfefba39ae51_0.webp)

## 🌍 Server Friendly
The modpack is fully compatible with regular servers.
You can easily join almost any server—mods are mostly client-side and don't require server-side installation.
![On server MastacBreeze](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74844d47bb4a360b3a001e09d5530eb9886266dc_0.webp)

# 🎯 Who is this modpack for?

This modpack is suitable if you want to:
- increase FPS and stability
- improve animations and visuals
- maintain vanilla gameplay
- play on any server

# 💡 Summary
This is a lightweight and convenient modpack that makes Minecraft more modern and enjoyable without disrupting the game's familiar atmosphere.
